long_biography.plain_text:
Patrick Joseph Dovigi was born in Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario, and began his career as an ice-hockey goaltender. He played in the Ontario Hockey League and was selected 41st overall by the Edmonton Oilers in the 1997 NHL draft. After leaving hockey and gaining experience in finance and environmental services, he founded GFL Environmental in 2007 around a one-stop environmental-solutions model.

Dovigi expanded GFL through organic growth and an acquisition programme that had completed more than 290 transactions by the end of 2025. The company went public in 2020, and he remains its founder, chairman, president and chief executive. GFL's latest annual filing describes it as North America's fourth-largest diversified environmental services company. A September 2025 securities filing attributed 25.7 million beneficially owned shares to Dovigi, directly linking his identifiable wealth to the company he created and leads. His philanthropy includes a 2019 donation of C$5 million to establish the Dovigi Family Sports Medicine Clinic.

The Canadian value was preserved, and no residence proposal was made because secondary residence is an optional rather than researchable field under the exact-input inventory.

These sources strongly align with the enriched current-vessel relationship but do not establish transparent legal ownership; the yacht was omitted from the biographies because buying it after completion does not explain his wealth origin, operating career or design patronage.
